user.title: Set up An Post
user.description: Sign in with the account you use on the An Post website or app. Your parcels are read from that account.

reauth_confirm.title: An Post sign-in expired
reauth_confirm.description: An Post no longer accepts the stored credentials. Enter them again for {account}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach An Post. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: That An Post account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different An Post account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up for.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration checks An Post for parcel updates. A slower interval is gentler on An Post's API; the default of 30 minutes is plenty for most parcels.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Add a bare tracking number to an An Post account's watchlist. An Post folds it into that account's regular parcel list automatically.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which configured An Post account's watchlist to add the number to.

tracking_code.name: Tracking number
tracking_code.description: The An Post tracking number (e.g. AB123456789IE).

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Remove a tracking number from an An Post account's watchlist.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Which configured An Post account's watchlist to remove the number from.

tracking_code.name: Tracking number
tracking_code.description: The An Post tracking number to stop watching.
